verdict_reason: The visibility change is harmless and lets AddressMapperTest use the production Jackson settings, but the touched method's name hides two of the three settings it applies.

todos.issue: camelCaseNamingStrategy() (line 21, made public in this PR so AddressMapperTest can call it) returns a customizer that also turns off failOnUnknownProperties and WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS (lines 25-26). The name predicts only the naming strategy and hides the other two behaviours, which the request-body handling relies on.
